description: Implementation of the SymFloat class and related functions for symbolic floating-point operations in the c10 namespace.

classes.name: SymFloat
classes.description: Class representing symbolic floating-point numbers with operations supporting symbolic and concrete values.

methods.name: toSymNodeImpl
methods.description: Converts SymFloat to a SymNode implementation, checking for symbolic status.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps the current SymFloat as a SymNode, either directly or via a base node.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds two SymFloat objects, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts two SymFloat objects, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplies two SymFloat objects, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Divides two SymFloat objects, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: sym_eq
methods.description: Checks equality between two SymFloat objects.

methods.name: sym_ne
methods.description: Checks inequality between two SymFloat objects.

methods.name: sym_lt
methods.description: Checks if one SymFloat is less than another.

methods.name: sym_le
methods.description: Checks if one SymFloat is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: sym_gt
methods.description: Checks if one SymFloat is greater than another.

methods.name: sym_ge
methods.description: Checks if one SymFloat is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two SymFloat objects.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two SymFloat objects.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Computes the square root of a SymFloat.

methods.name: guard_float
methods.description: Returns the float value, guarding symbolic values with file and line info.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Checks if the SymNode has a hint.
